class.name: SpineMesh3D
class.brief_description: Internal mesh node used by [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] to render one skeleton slot.
class.description: [code]SpineMesh3D[/code] is an internal [code]MeshInstance3D[/code]. [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] creates one [code]SpineMesh3D[/code] per skeleton slot. Each instance owns an [code]ArrayMesh[/code] surface with deformed vertices, UVs, vertex colors, and indices for its slot. The parent updates geometry and materials every frame. Do not add [code]SpineMesh3D[/code] nodes to your scene yourself. Use [code]SpineSprite3D[/code] for gameplay and editor preview. Internal children are editor-locked so clicks select the parent [code]SpineSprite3D[/code]. Slot depth sorting uses draw order offsets on materials and vertex Z offsets.
